[पुष्-घञ्] 
__1 Nourishing, supporting, maintaining. 
__2 Nourishment, growth, increase, advance. 
__3 Prosperity, plenty, abundance.
One who maintains or nourishes, a supporter.
a. One who feeds, nourishes &c. -m. A feeder.

पोषिन्,
पोष्टृ a. [पुष्-णिनि तृच् च] One who feeds, nourishes &c. -m. A feeder, nourisher, protector.

a. [पुष्-कर्मणि ण्यत्] 
__1 To be fed, nourished or supported. 
__2 Well-fed, thriving. 
__3 Causing prosperity. 
__4 Abundant, copious. 
-Comp. 
-पुत्रः, -सुतः an adopted son; अधुना कृत्तिकादीनां षण्णां यः पोष्यपुत्रकः । तन्नाम चक्रुस्ताः प्रेम्णा कार्तिकश्चेति कौतुकात् ॥ [[Brav. P.]] 
-वर्गः a class of relatives, who must be nourished and protected.
